70b_stage1_basis.method: promix.quantize.basis, FP32 CPU-resident model, layer-by-layer streamed to 1 GPU (built-in layer offload)
70b_stage1_basis.eigendecomp: per-layer basis 80/80 in ~5 s + 2x 30-chunk eig ~46 s each

70b_stage2_deltaD_alloc.includes: build_base (ring512 substrate, offload) + deltaD collection 4096 tokens + allocation math

70b_stage3_gptq_scales.includes: model load (30 shards ~114 s) + RMSNorm fold + rotation (80 layers, 22:53) + frozen-scale GPTQ + two-level scale + weight/act-MSE, CPU-resident layer offload

70b_stage4_pack_export.status: not run (70B never exported: vLLM plugin is single-GPU, no TP; disk-blocked, see common.sh 70b lane)
70b_stage4_pack_export.estimate: GPU pack throughput from 8B (12.4 s / 6.98e9 weights) scales to ~2 min GPU-side for 68.5e9 weights; offload + ~43 GB checkpoint write dominates, ~5-10 min total (estimate, not measured)

offload_note: All 70B stages run with PROMIX_LOAD_DEVICE=cpu (CPU-resident weights, per-layer GPU streaming), single RTX PRO 6000.
